check.title: Fix before sending
check.intro: Check a draft against the customer portal's published rules before you send it. Nothing is ever sent from here, and a fix only changes this draft.
check.subcontractor: A subcontractor worked on this job
check.noOrders: No work orders yet. Import some on the Import tab.
check.noActiveRules: No reviewed portal rules are active yet, so nothing was checked. Rules start in review and only apply once a reviewer approves them.
check.loadFailed: Could not load the portal rules.
check.draftNote: Draft only. Nothing has been sent.

fix.reduce_total_to_cap: Reduce the invoice to the NTE.
fix.create_proposal: Submit a proposal to raise the NTE first.
fix.wait_for_approval: Wait for the proposal to be approved.
fix.enter_nte: Enter the NTE from the portal.
fix.contact_client: Ask the customer whether they will accept it.
fix.merge_into_existing_invoice: Add the charges to the existing invoice.

risk.title: Money at risk
risk.intro: Open work orders where money may be lost. Measured amounts come from a real invoice total or the exact amount over the NTE. Estimated amounts come from your working estimate or proposal. They are never added together.
risk.unknownHint: {{count}} orders have no invoice, estimate or proposal amount.
risk.empty: Nothing is at risk right now.
risk.notCounted: Also in a higher-priority group; counted once.

candidates.title: Patterns in your rejections
candidates.intro: Suggestions only, grouped by keyword from the reasons you recorded. A reviewer decides whether any becomes a rule. Nothing here is saved or turned on.
candidates.empty: No repeated rejection reasons yet. Record the reason on rejected invoices to see patterns.
candidates.covered: A rule of this kind already exists
candidates.notCovered: No rule of this kind yet
